_why: Starting values for the Intercepta setup page. They live here, not in source, because npm run verify refuses a hardcoded endpoint in src/ or scripts/ — and because a value without its provenance is a value nobody can re-check.
_confirmed: Every value below has now been confirmed by calling the API on 2026-09-26. Raw request/response bodies, key redacted, are in docs/build/evidence/intercepta-live.json. The response has no field called clean or flagged: it returns a score and a list of traits, so the mapping onto ScreeningResult is a threshold we chose and defend in src/adapters/intercepta.ts.

INTERCEPTA_BASE_URL.source: CONFIRMED 2026-09-26 — the API host named in the public reference the prize page points at, https://docs.web3antivirus.io, and the host that answered 200 for both a clean and a flagged address.

INTERCEPTA_SCAN_PATH.source: CONFIRMED 2026-09-26 — Quick Scan, chosen over Deep Scan (.../toxic-score). Both answer 200 and both carry the human-readable trait description rule 4 shows a person, so the reason is not the deciding factor. Quick Scan wins on two: an ordinary wallet comes back with an empty trait list rather than incidental exposure (Deep Scan reports non_kyc_transfers at 0.04 on the same wallet), and it is the endpoint the provider documents as the low-latency one — this call runs before every settlement.

INTERCEPTA_AUTH_HEADER.source: CONFIRMED 2026-09-26 — x-api-key and X-API-KEY both answer 200. authorization: Bearer, apikey, api-key and no header at all all answer 403, 'This authentication key is incorrect or doesn't exist'. It was a guess when this file was written; it is not one now.

clean.source: CONFIRMED 2026-09-26 — a public, widely-known mainnet wallet (vitalik.eth). Quick Scan answered {"toxicScore":0,"traits":[]}. Used as the demo's declared payment source so that the live call before a settlement is a real call against a real mainnet address; it is not the wallet of whoever is running the demo.

flagged.source: CONFIRMED 2026-09-26 — the Ronin bridge exploiter, an OFAC SDN listing. Quick Scan answered toxicScore 100 with traits known_scammer, sanction_address and blacklist, each at risk 100 and each carrying its own description.

fixtures._traps: Two addresses that look like obvious fixtures and are not. 0x722122dF12D4e14e13Ac3b6895a86e84145b6967 (Tornado Cash proxy, OFAC SDN) answers 404 — this endpoint is account-scoped and that address is a contract, so it maps to unavailable, never to clean. 0x8589427373D6D84E98730D7795D8f6f8731FDA16 (Tornado Cash router, OFAC SDN) answers toxicScore 0 on both endpoints. This API is not a sanctions oracle and must not be described as one.

keys.source: Where the API reference lives. Sandbox keys come from the prize page's form: one key, 1,000 requests, valid through judging.
